ServicePackageHeader.Title: LEVEL 1: Root Cause Analysis
ServicePackageHeader.Description:
An issue that can be duplicated consistently may include a DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Code) or multiple related DTC’s but involves a single vehicle system.
A/C system root cause analysis
Evap system smoke testing
Basic driveability concerns including sensor pinpoint testing, ignition system checks, injector testing (not including flow rate), propane or supplemental fuel testing, etc….

ServicePackageHeader.Title: Alignment
ServicePackageHeader.Description: Inspect steering and suspension system components.  Connect alignment equipment to verify and adjust front and rear wheel alignment settings for caster, camber, and toe in/out settings, thrust angle where applicable and center steering wheel.  Some vehicles may require installation of alignment shims at additional charges.  Adjust to meet manufacturers’ specifications.  Perform final road test where applicable.

ServicePackageHeader.Title: Rear Sub Frame
ServicePackageHeader.Description: Remove and Replace components as required to access and install materials, and/or perform needed service, adjustments as required.  Retest and verify repair as required.  Perform final road test where applicable.

ServicePackageHeader.Title: BG Brake Fluid System Flush
ServicePackageHeader.Description: Connect flush equipment to remove existing fluid.  Additional flush and cleaning chemicals may be added to assist in cleaning system contamination.  Fill system fluid(s) to proper capacity with new fluid.  Fluid additives and/or conditioners may be added to system.  Leak test vehicle system.  Perform final road test where applicable.

ServicePackageHeader.Title: Air Conditioning Compressor
ServicePackageHeader.Description: Remove and Replace components as required to access and install materials, and/or perform needed service.  Air Conditioning repairs which include replacement materials will normally require an additional service to evacuate and recharge system refrigerant and oil.  Retest and verify repair as required.  Perform final road test where applicable.

ServicePackageHeader.Title: Evacuate and Recharge R134A Air Conditioning System
ServicePackageHeader.Description: Connect AC equipment, evacuate system of contaminates, verify system pressures, refrigerant levels and cooling vent temperature.  Charge AC system, install proper refrigerant and oil capacity. Leak test AC system.  Refrigerant leak detection dye may be added to system.
